items.docs: Returns alert rules across all models in the workspace, including rules attached indirectly via policy assignments. Applies the caller's per-model RBAC. Requires workspace_list_alert_rules permission.

Performs static validation of an alert rule SQL query without requiring a model. Checks syntax, allowed tables, allowed functions, clause restrictions, and template presence. Does not execute the query.
Returns a single alert rule by ID. Requires alert_rule_read permission.
Updates an alert rule. Requires alert_rule_update permission.
Deletes a single alert rule by ID. Requires alert_rule_delete permission.
